summary: Odysight.ai filed an 8-K reporting an underwriting agreement with Roth Capital Partners for a firm-commitment public offering of 3,437,500 shares at $3.20 per share, roughly $11 million gross, plus a 30-day option for 515,625 shares (15%). The offering was made under an effective Form S-3 shelf, with customary indemnification, lock-ups for directors and officers, and expected close on or about August 21, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; proceeds fund R&D, sales and marketing scale-up, and general corporate purposes. Watch pricing pressure from the 15% greenshoe overhang.
